topic: 近一年已发表论文中的具身智能数据质量
notes: Resolved '近一年' as 2025-07-08 through 2026-07-08. The run used an EA-DATA/EVAL/MODEL/SENSOR query plan plus a second quality-focused arXiv query round for data selection, demonstration filtering, curation, dataset distillation, and quality diversity. 133 deduplicated broad candidates and 17 quality-focused candidates were screened; 12 papers with arXiv HTML extraction and topic-relevant locators were promoted to accepted evidence. Candidate lists and HTML extraction outputs remain in work/literature-review-embodied-data-quality-last-year-20260708/. Web search was used to verify high-relevance arXiv abs records. The output is an arXiv/public-paper snapshot, not a peer-reviewed-only census.
